assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: isolated transparent full-body astronaut sprite for a children's skip-counting game. Use the reference animal's face, colours and friendly personality as identity/style reference. Create one adorable lime green frog with cream belly and large friendly amber eyes wearing a cute rounded mint green and ivory suit with teal trim. Oversized head inside a clear bubble helmet, with NO glare covering the face, tiny arms by sides, two short boots grounded on the same flat baseline. Front-facing with slight three-quarter view, welcoming smile, whole helmet and all limbs visible. Helmet and head occupy the upper 55 percent of the silhouette so the same sprite can be cropped for a pod passenger. Compact proportions, soft storybook cartoon shading, gentle crisp outline. Plain empty chest panel for a number badge to be added by code. No numbers, no writing, no props, no planet, no floor, no shadow outside character, no outer glow. Genuine transparent background.
